events.body:
## Summary

Update docs and UI copy so BLT-Hackathons reflects the current GitLab-first direction, generated-JSON stats model, and Cloudflare Pages deployment target while preserving GitHub support where true.

## Scope

- Remove or update stale GitHub-only wording.
- Fix docs that still describe browser-live GitHub API stats as the core model.
- Explain that generated JSON under `public/hackathon-data/` is the frontend data source.
- Explain GitLab support and Cloudflare Pages clearly.
- Keep GitHub support documented for GitHub-backed events.

## Suggested files

- Modify: `README.md`
- Modify: `FEATURES.md`
- Modify: `SETUP.md`
- Modify: `TESTING.md`
- Modify: `SUMMARY.md` or mark it historical
- Modify: `AGENT.md` if source contracts change
- Modify UI copy in `public/index.html`, `public/hackathon.html`, `public/js/index.js`, `public/js/main.js` as needed

## Known stale areas

- README still has GitHub Pages/GitHub Issues as primary in several places.
- Some docs still describe browser/client-side GitHub API processing instead of generated JSON stats.
- Support links should point to GitLab canonical project where appropriate.
- `SUMMARY.md` describes an older architecture and may be better marked as historical.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Docs name GitLab project `https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-hackathons` as canonical.
- [ ] Docs name Cloudflare Pages as the deployment target.
- [ ] Docs explain generated JSON stats under `public/hackathon-data/`.
- [ ] GitHub support remains documented for GitHub-backed events.
- [ ] GitHub-only setup instructions are either updated, moved to compatibility notes, or labeled historical.
- [ ] UI copy avoids saying GitHub where the event/provider may be GitLab.
- [ ] Search for stale phrases returns no unintentional matches.

## Verification

Search for stale strings such as:

```text
GitHub Pages
GitHub Issues
GitHub API Integration
client-side processing
real-time updates
pull requests
```

Review each remaining match and keep only the ones that are intentionally about GitHub-backed events.

---

Moved from https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-hackathons/-/issues/11 (opened by @mdkaifansari04 on 2026-06-07).

**Discussion summary**

- Still open: `README.md` keeps a "Deployed on GitHub Pages" badge and a "Deploy to GitHub Pages" section.
- The canonical project is now the `blt-hackathons` folder of git.owaspblt.org/BLT, not gitlab.com; the acceptance criteria that name GitLab should name the forge instead.
events.title: blt-hackathons: Clean stale GitHub-only docs and copy
